title: RUN GOALS PAY REWARDS NOT SP
why: His order 2026-10-28: sp is like a high score counter. Watch: run goals pay $ or items at the undercroft, never sp
now: Simple goals carry $1,000 to $1,500; hard goals carry a cache item. Extract to bank them, die or abandon to lose them. Demo goals give each seat a power-up. Goals never feed SP.
